How to explore the strip & a few field notes +

Drag the ribbon to change your view. Scroll or use a two-finger pinch to zoom. Turn changes rotation speed; Drift changes the movement of the liquid-gold pattern. Space or the Pause button freezes motion. Reset restores the viewing angle and zoom.

This is an idealized mathematical surface with a stylized gold shader, not a simulation of real molten metal. Interactive rendering requires WebGL. If WebGL is unavailable, a still preview appears instead. A reduced-motion preference starts the viewer paused.
